title: Two Strikes on a Number Line
description: A number line from 0 to 12 with a teal jump from 0 to 4 and an amber jump from 4 to 7; the coin stops at 7, marked P, with the captions 4 + 3 = 7 and P = a + b.

title: A Leftward Strike Is a Negative Movement
description: A number line from −5 to 6 marked −ve on the left and +ve on the right. A teal jump goes right from 0 to 5 and an amber jump goes left from 5 to −2, where the coin stops, marked P, with the caption 5 + (−7) = −2.

topic_name: Tokens: Subtracting by Adding Zero Pairs
title: Putting In Zero Pairs to Find 7 − 18
description: Three rows of tokens: 7 greens; then 18 greens above 11 reds with the 11 zero pairs outlined; then the 18 greens struck through, leaving 11 reds and the label (+7) − (+18) = −11.

topic_name: Tokens: Subtracting by Adding Zero Pairs
title: Taking Away Reds Is Adding Greens
labels: put in 12 zero pairs, remove 12 reds
description: Two rows of tokens. Top: 4 greens and 12 outlined zero pairs with all 12 reds struck, leaving 16 greens, 4 − (−12) = 16. Bottom: 4 greens and 12 greens, 4 + 12 = 16.

title: Putting Groups In: 4 × 2 and 4 × (−2)
description: Two rows of four bags. Top: 2 greens in each bag, 4 × 2 = 8. Bottom: 2 reds in each bag, 4 × (−2) = −8, with multiplier, multiplicand and product labelled.

title: Taking Groups Out of an Empty Bag
description: Two rows of four bags of zero pairs. In the top row the greens are struck out, leaving 8 reds: (−4) × 2 = −8. In the bottom row the reds are struck out, leaving 8 greens: (−4) × (−2) = 8.

title: Three Token Sets for −2
description: Three panels of tokens: 2 reds; 4 reds and 2 greens with 2 zero pairs outlined; 6 reds and 4 greens with 4 zero pairs outlined. Each panel leaves 2 unpaired reds and is labelled −2.

title: Down the Ladder: Taking 3 Away Below Zero
labels: the pattern goes on below zero
description: A ladder of eight multiplications with multiplicand 3, from 4 × 3 = 12 at the top to −3 × 3 = −9 at the bottom, each pair of neighbouring rungs joined by a down arrow labelled −3, and a dashed line marking where the multiplier goes below zero.

title: Up the Ladder: Adding 3 Past Zero
labels: the pattern goes on below zero
description: A ladder of eight multiplications with multiplicand −3, from 4 × (−3) = −12 at the top to (−3) × (−3) = 9 at the bottom, each pair of neighbouring rungs joined by a down arrow labelled +3, and a dashed line marking where the multiplier goes below zero.

title: Two Descents in the Mine Shaft
description: A mine shaft through a hill with the book's levels from +180 m to −175 m. A teal arrow runs from 0 m down to −180 m, just below the lowest marked level, and an amber arrow runs from 15 m down to −120 m, just above the −125 m level.

title: Circle and Strike: Four Rounds
description: Four copies of the grid, one per round. The circles build up as −6, 14, 20 and 18, and each circle brings a grey line through its row and its column, until every row and column holds one circle.

title: Every Cell Is Row Number × Column Number
labels: each cell = row number × column number
description: The magic grid drawn as a multiplication table, with row numbers 2, −7, 3, 5 on the left and column numbers 4, −2, 6, −3 on top. The cell −42 is ringed where row −7 meets column 6.

title: The Products of −1 Ladder
description: A ladder of four rows: two, three, four and five factors of −1, with products 1, −1, 1 and −1, and a × −1 arrow joining each row to the next. Captions under it read even: positive and odd: negative.

title: One Rectangle, Two Readings: 4 × (2 + (−3))
description: A rectangle of 4 rows, each of 2 green tokens then 3 red tokens. Braces mark the green block as 4 × 2 = 8, the red block as 4 × (−3) = −12, and the whole rectangle as 4 × (2 + (−3)) = −4.

title: Machine 1: One Rule Fits Every Row
description: Machine 1 with six rows of three inputs and an output star. Every row has a plus sign between the first two inputs and a minus sign before the third, and the last star, highlighted, holds −13.

title: Machine 2: The Inverse of the Product, Then Subtract
description: Machine 2 with six rows. A middle column shows the inverse of the product of the first two inputs, and the star shows that value minus the third input; the last star, highlighted, holds −111.

title: The Terhüchü Board at the Start
description: A Terhüchü board: a 4 by 4 square with its long diagonals and a diamond of diagonals, 8 triangles around it, 9 teal coins at the top and 9 amber coins at the bottom in the starting position.

title: The Sign Grid: Matching Signs Give Positive Products
description: The chapter's 7 by 7 sign grid: the factor bands −3 to 3 cross at the centre, positive products fill the top right and bottom left quarters, and negative products fill the top left and bottom right quarters, with the same sizes, such as 9, 6 and 4, in every quarter.
